svg.title: D66: From prototype to production in steps
svg.desc: D66 is a flow diagram, not to scale. Five steps run left to right: 5 prototypes that prove the design; a pilot build of 20; 200 boards with first articles at the start; 1,000 boards, the first large batch, which runs slower while the assembler learns the board; then full volume, released in batches of whole panels, shown as batches of 27 boards from a 9-up panel. Each step is wider than the last, because it builds more boards.

g.text: A pilot build shows what was done by hand
Replace hand-fitted and hard-to-find parts now
First articles, if anything changed since the last build
One panel at least, checked before the rest are built
The first large batch runs slower
The assembler learns the board; expect a few more issues
Full volume, released in batches of whole panels
Each square is one 9-up panel; a batch of 3 panels is 27 boards
